title: Polish magical working animating a golem, then Nazi tanks
summary: Whitley Strieber tells of Polish magical working animating a golem, then Nazi tanks, about 1930s (told in 1970s) at Poland; China; New York party, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I was doing the magical working, she said, in a in Poland in the 1930s

plain: A writer named Whitley Strieber says on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels that at a party in New York in the 1970s, a woman told him she had done a magical working, a ritual, in Poland in the 1930s. As he tells it, the story involved bringing a golem, a clay figure from Jewish folklore, to life, and was tied to the Nazi tanks that later came, with General Joseph Stilwell also part of what she related. If true, it would mean ritual magic had a hand in the events leading into the Second World War.
